# Loan portfolio

Portfolio quality, concentration and vintage analysis for `mart_loan_portfolio`.
Ratios are recomputed from counts and balances — never by averaging a ratio column.

## Portfolio quality

```{r}
#| echo: false
q <- read_table("loan_portfolio_quality")
if (!is.null(q)) print(q) else cat("No portfolio-quality table in this run.\n")
```

## Concentration by loan type

HHI and top-N share of outstanding amount.

```{r}
#| echo: false
conc <- read_table("loan_concentration_by_type")
if (!is.null(conc)) print(conc) else cat("No concentration table in this run.\n")
```

## Vintage and survival

Cohort triangles (`vintage_triangle()`) and Kaplan–Meier time-to-default
(`survival_fit()`) are available in `R/mart_loan_portfolio.R`. Open loans are
right-censored, not "good" — never drop them from duration analysis.
